# Social Daily Report - New Layout

One schedule trigger (10:00 GMT+8) and **one** consolidated Slack message (channel `social-reports`).

### Flow
`Daily 10:00 GMT+8` -> `Load snapshot` -> `Accounts config` -> `Only enabled accounts` -> one `Filter: <X>` + one fixed-ID `Fetch <X>` (Execute Workflow) per platform -> `Merge Platforms` -> `Merge` (+ `Fetch link clicks`) -> `Build report` -> `Save snapshot` -> `Has baseline?` -> `Send report to Slack`

**8 Fetch nodes:** Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (disabled), LinkedIn (Company Page, official API), LinkedIn Profile (personal profile via Apify -- routed by `platform: 'LinkedIn Profile'`, but its rows come back as platform `LinkedIn`), Threads. Link clicks come from `Fetch link clicks` (Bitly workflow).

### Why one Fetch node per platform instead of 1 dynamic one
The old design used a single `Fetch metrics` node with a dynamic `workflowId` expression, looping over every enabled account in "each" mode. Confirmed by direct testing: n8n's engine crashes (`assignPairedItems`, "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'entries')") whenever that one node has to call a REPEATED workflow ID (2 accounts of the same platform) mixed with a DIFFERENT workflow ID in the same loop. Each platform now has its own Execute Workflow node with a hardcoded ID, so it only ever repeats the SAME id across its own accounts -- the one pattern confirmed safe.

### Add / remove / disable an account
Edit **Accounts config** only (`platform`, `channel`, `account_id`, `enabled`). The Filter nodes route by `platform`, which already matches every value Accounts config produces.

### Add a NEW platform
1. Build a `Social Fetch - <Platform>` workflow that returns the standard row schema.
2. Add its workflow ID to `FETCHERS` and its accounts in **Accounts config**.
3. Copy a Filter + Fetch pair, set the new `platform` / workflow ID.
4. Raise **Merge Platforms** `numberInputs` and connect the new Fetch to the new input.
5. In **Build report** add the platform to `ACCOUNTS` (channel names), `PLATFORM_ORDER` and `PLATFORM_LOGOS`.

### What the report shows
Per account (Dr. Brand B, Brand A) and platform: new posts (24h) + top posts (7 days). Then two link tables from Bitly: **Link performance** (webinar links, `TRACKED_LINKS`) and **Free Masterclass link performance** (`MASTERCLASS_LINKS`). Both lists must match the `Tracked links` node in **Social Fetch - Bitly**. A metric a platform does not expose (e.g. LinkedIn personal-profile views) shows as N/A.

### Snapshot
All platforms share one key `social_all_v1` in **Social Snapshot Store**. Posts are keyed `platform|channel|id`; links by short URL. Changes (+/-) compare against the previous run.

### Failure handling
Each `Fetch <Platform>` node runs with **Continue on error**, so one dead platform cannot break the report -- it just contributes no rows.

## Status

**Facebook + Instagram are LIVE** using a short-lived (~2 month) User token pasted into the *Facebook Graph account* credential.
Remember to renew this token before it expires, or switch to a System User token (expiration = Never) to avoid repeating this every 2 months.

**TikTok / YouTube / X** are still `enabled: false`.
Open each `Social Fetch - ...` workflow to see what it needs.

# Social Daily Report - New Layout
Runs 10:00 AM GMT+8 and posts **one** Slack message (`social-reports`).

**Flow:** `Load snapshot` -> `Accounts config` -> `Only enabled accounts` -> one `Filter` + `Fetch` per platform (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Profile, Threads) -> `Merge Platforms` -> `Merge` (+ `Fetch link clicks` = Bitly) -> `Build report` -> `Save snapshot` -> `Slack`.

**Add / remove / disable an account:** edit **Accounts config** only.
**New platform:** new `Social Fetch` workflow + Filter/Fetch pair, raise `Merge Platforms` inputs, add it to `ACCOUNTS` / `PLATFORM_ORDER` / `PLATFORM_LOGOS` in `Build report`.

**Why one Fetch node per platform:** a single dynamic Execute Workflow node crashes n8n (`assignPairedItems`) when it mixes repeated and different workflow IDs.

**Link tables:** `TRACKED_LINKS` / `MASTERCLASS_LINKS` in `Build report` must match `Tracked links` in the Bitly workflow. Snapshot key: `social_all_v1`. Fetch nodes use Continue on error.
